components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for key conversions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #047857 0%, #064e3b 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #065f46; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #065f46 0%, #022c22 100%); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); }

narrative.overview: AgriSense & AgriMarket pairs the organic reliability of cultivated soil with the crisp analytical precision of satellite remote sensing and autonomous AI trade. Built for high-sunlight outdoor fieldwork, agricultural trade floors, and desktop research consoles, the interface prioritizes immediate legibility, human craftsmanship, and functional calm over decorative tech tropes.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Forest Emerald accent color is reserved for primary actions, active navigation items, and verified trust markers. It covers ≤12% of screen area.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Never render green text lighter than #047857 on white or light backgrounds. Neon green (#10b981) is prohibited as text on light surfaces.

rules.name: The 12px Absolute Floor
rules.body: No functional, readable, or interactive text element anywhere in the user interface shall have a font-size below 12px.

rules.name: The Halo Prohibition
rules.body: Zero colored glow shadows (box-shadow: 0 0 10px #10b981). Elevation is communicated solely through neutral lighting and crisp 1px borders.

dos: Do maintain a strict 12px minimum floor on all functional UI text.
Do use #047857 or #064e3b for all primary emerald accents on light backgrounds.
Do use Outfit as the primary typography family across all views.
Do use exponential deceleration (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for micro-interactions.
Do use multi-layer neutral slate shadows for elevation.
donts: Don't use #10b981 as text on white or light backgrounds (fails WCAG AA contrast).
Don't use chunky border-left: 4px / 6px colored side tabs.
Don't nest cards inside other cards.
Don't use infinite pulsing animations on static indicators.
Don't use bouncy or springy animation easing.
